
================================================================================
SLMN SOUND - FULL PROJECT DOCUMENTATION & RECREATION GUIDE
================================================================================

This document serves as the comprehensive blueprint for the SLMN Sound application.
It covers architecture, file structures, component logic, and the exact steps
needed to recreate or extend the platform.

================================================================================
(1) PROJECT OVERVIEW
================================================================================
SLMN Sound is a premium e-commerce platform for electronic music producers. 
It sells sample packs, synth presets, and digital tools.

Key Features:
- Product catalog with categories (Samples, Presets)
- Live Audio Auditioning (Waveform visualization)
- Interactive 3D WebGL Studio/Visualizations using Three.js
- Cart and Checkout system (Stripe integration ready)
- User Accounts, Purchase History, and Subscription Management
- Full Dark/Light mode support with glowing cyan accent themes

Tech Stack:
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, React Router 7
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Custom CSS Variables
- Animations: Framer Motion
- 3D/Graphics: Three.js, React Three Fiber (implied/custom), WebGL
- Audio: Wavesurfer.js
- Database & Auth: PocketBase v0.25+

================================================================================

================================================================================

    │   └── CartContext.jsx      # Shopping cart state (localStorage)

    │   ├── LoginPage.jsx
    │   ├── SignupPage.jsx
    │   └── ... (Success/Cancel pages)
    ├── styles/                  # Supplemental CSS
    └── lite/                    # Beginner friendly sub-app

================================================================================
(3) DEPENDENCIES & SETUP
================================================================================
Core Dependencies:
- react, react-dom (^18.3.1)
- react-router-dom (^7.13.0)
- framer-motion (^11.15.0) - For page transitions and smooth UI
- lucide-react (^0.469.0) - Consistent SVG icons
- pocketbase (^0.25.0) - CRITICAL: Version 0.25.0+ required for proper auth API
- three (^0.160.0) - For 3D Audio visualization
- wavesurfer.js (^7.0.0) - Audio waveform rendering
- tailwindcss (^3.4.17) - Utility-first styling
- sonner (^2.0.7) - Toast notifications

================================================================================
(4) STEP-BY-STEP SETUP
================================================================================
1. Initialize Project:
   npm create vite@latest slmn-sound -- --template react
   cd slmn-sound
   npm install

2. Install Key Dependencies:
   npm install react-router-dom pocketbase framer-motion lucide-react three wavesurfer.js react-helmet sonner

3. Setup Tailwind CSS:
   npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
   npx tailwindcss init -p

4. Configure PocketBase:
   Download PocketBase, start it: `./pocketbase serve`
   Create the collections detailed in Section 6.

5. Start Dev Server:
   npm run dev

================================================================================
(5) ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
================================================================================
React Router Structure:
<Router>
  <AuthProvider>
    <CartProvider>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<HomePage />} />
        <Route path="/account" element={<ProtectedRoute><AccountDashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
      </Routes>
    </CartProvider>
  </AuthProvider>
</Router>

- AuthProvider sits at the top to secure routes.
- CartProvider wraps the app so cart state is accessible globally (e.g., Header badge).
- Page components fetch their own data using `pb.collection().getFullList()`.
- Shared UI (Header, Footer) are rendered inside individual pages or layouts.

================================================================================
(6) DATABASE SCHEMA (PocketBase)
================================================================================
1. users (Type: Auth)
   - email, password, name, avatar (file)

2. products (Type: Base)
   - id, name (text), description (text), price (number)
   - category (select: Sample Packs, Serum Presets, etc)
   - productImage (file), productFile (file, digital download)
   - fileFormat (text), demoUrl (text)

3. orders (Type: Base)
   - userId (text/relation), stripeSessionId (text), totalAmount (number)
   - status (select: pending, completed, failed), items (json)

4. orderItems (Type: Base)
   - orderId (relation to orders), productId (text), productName (text)
   - price (number), downloadUrl (text)

5. sounds (Type: Base)
   - title (text), description (text), category (select)
   - audioUrl (text), duration (number), audioFile (file)

CRITICAL PB CONFIG: Disable AutoCancel. 
Always use `{ $autoCancel: false }` in PB API calls in React.

================================================================================
(7) AUTHENTICATION SYSTEM
================================================================================
Managed in `src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx`.

Flow:
1. `pb.authStore.isValid` determines initial auth state.
2. Login: `pb.collection('users').authWithPassword(email, password, { $autoCancel: false })`
3. Signup: Creates record, then automatically logs in.
4. Logout: `pb.authStore.clear()`
5. ProtectedRoutes check `isAuthenticated` and redirect to `/login` if false.

================================================================================
(8) PAGES & COMPONENTS
================================================================================
HomePage: Hero section with dynamic 3D Background. Product feature highlights.
ProductsPage: Fetches `products` collection. Renders `ProductCard` grid. Filters by category.
ProductDetailPage: Fetches single product via `useParams()`. Adds to cart.
MediaPage: Showcases DJ mixes, tutorials, resources using dynamic tabs.
StudioPage: Full interactive Three.js workspace for audio visualizations.
AccountDashboard: Pulls `orders` where `userId = currentUser.id`. Manages subscriptions.
CartPage: Maps context `cart` array, calculates totals, triggers checkout.

================================================================================
(9) DARK/LIGHT MODE
================================================================================
In `index.css`:
:root { --background: 0 0% 100%; ... }
.dark { --background: 0 0% 5%; ... }

The `useTheme` hook toggles the `.dark` class on the `<html>` element and saves 
the preference in localStorage. Tailwind uses `dark:bg-...` or simply adapts 
to `hsl(var(--background))` automatically based on the applied class.

================================================================================
(10) 3D VIEWER & INTERACTIVE MODELS
================================================================================
Implemented using vanilla Three.js inside React `useEffect`.
- `mountRef` captures the DOM node for the WebGL canvas.
- A `scene`, `camera`, and `renderer` are instantiated.
- Visualizations (e.g., Particle systems, Icosahedrons) update rotation inside `requestAnimationFrame`.
- Cleanup is critical: `cancelAnimationFrame`, `dispose()` geometries/materials, and remove DOM elements on unmount.

================================================================================
(11) SUBSCRIPTION SYSTEM
================================================================================
Component: `SubscriptionManagement.jsx`
- Simulates or fetches from a `subscriptions` PB collection.
- Displays current tier, Next Billing Date, and Action Buttons (Upgrade/Cancel).
- Includes mock loading states and success/error Toasts.
- When Stripe is fully integrated, buttons here redirect to Stripe Customer Portal.

================================================================================
(12) CART & CHECKOUT
================================================================================
`CartContext.jsx`:
- Stores cart array in `localStorage`.
- `addToCart`: checks for existing ID, increments quantity or appends to array.
- `updateQuantity`: increments/decrements. Removes if quantity <= 0.
- Checkout flow uses `CheckoutButton.jsx` which talks to an API server `/stripe/create-checkout` 
  using `apiServerClient.fetch`.

================================================================================
(13) AUDIO PLAYER
================================================================================
Components: `AudioPlayerCard.jsx`, `WaveformVisualization.jsx`
- Uses `wavesurfer.js` to render audio waveforms dynamically.
- `WaveformVisualization` wraps wavesurfer in a `forwardRef` to expose play/pause/seek controls to parent.
- `pb.files.getUrl(record, record.audioFile)` constructs secure URLs for PB file fields.

================================================================================
(14) STYLING APPROACH
================================================================================
- Variables: HSL values defined in `index.css` (e.g., `222.2 84% 4.9%`).
- Applied via Tailwind: `bg-background`, `text-primary`.
- Semantic pairing: Always pair `bg-primary` with `text-primary-foreground`.
- Glassmorphism: `bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-md`.
- Neumorphic Neon: `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_hsl(var(--primary)/0.6)]` for glowing elements in Dark mode.

================================================================================
(15) ROUTING STRUCTURE
================================================================================
/ -> HomePage
/products -> ProductsPage
/product/:id -> ProductDetailPage
/sounds -> SoundPreviewPage
/media -> MediaPage
/studio -> StudioPage
/cart -> CartPage
/login -> LoginPage
/signup -> SignupPage
/account -> ProtectedRoute wrapping AccountDashboard

================================================================================
(16) STATE MANAGEMENT
================================================================================
- Local State (`useState`): Tab switching, form inputs, loading toggles.
- Context (`useAuth`, `useCart`): Global user data, cart items.
- No Redux or Zustand is needed. PB acts as the single source of truth for remote state.

================================================================================
(17) FILE UPLOAD & STORAGE
================================================================================
PocketBase File Fields:
- When uploading: Use `FormData` to append files and text fields, then send via `pb.collection().create(formData)`.
- When rendering: `const url = pb.files.getUrl(record, record.productImage, { thumb: '100x100' })`

================================================================================
(18) COMMON PATTERNS
================================================================================
- Error Boundaries/Handling: try/catch blocks in async functions, displaying `toast.error(err.message)`.
- Loading Skeletons: `<div className="animate-pulse bg-muted rounded-xl h-48" />`.
- Button disabling on submit: `<Button disabled={loading}>...</Button>`.

================================================================================
(19) HOW TO ADD NEW FEATURES
================================================================================
Example: Adding a "Blog"
1. Add PB Collection: `blog_posts` (title, content, image, author).
2. Create `src/pages/BlogPage.jsx`.
3. Fetch data: `pb.collection('blog_posts').getFullList({ $autoCancel: false })`.
4. Map over data and render UI.
5. Add route to `App.jsx`: `<Route path="/blog" element={<BlogPage />} />`.
6. Add link to `Header.jsx`.

================================================================================
(20) DEPLOYMENT
================================================================================
- Build: `npm run build`
- Output goes to `/dist` directory.
- Deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or Hostinger.
- PocketBase must be deployed to a VPS or managed hosting, and the production URL mapped to the frontend API client.

================================================================================
(21) TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================
- "pb is not defined": Ensure `import pb from '@/lib/pocketbaseClient'` is at the top.
- "Does the file exist?": Check Vite import extensions (`.jsx`).
- "Objects are not valid as a React child": Ensure you aren't rendering a raw object. Use `item.name`.
- PB Auto-cancellation: If API calls abort randomly, add `{ $autoCancel: false }` to the options object.
- Safari OAuth Popups Blocked: Ensure `authWithOAuth2` is called in a synchronous `.then()` chain from the click handler, not `async/await`.

================================================================================
(22) LEARNING NOTES
================================================================================
- Performance: Three.js scenes must dispose of geometry/materials on unmount to prevent severe memory leaks.
- Contrast: Never nest `text-foreground` inside a `bg-primary` div. Use `text-primary-foreground`.
- Security: Never expose raw PB admin credentials. Rely on PB's `listRule` and `viewRule` for RLS (Row Level Security).
